description: Use this when you need the custom domains on the signed-in account, including DNS status. Read-only; requires auth; no inputs. Returns {object:"list", data:[{id, domain, status, status_detail, mail, records, warnings, dns}]}. Each record has status valid, missing, or invalid, found from the last check, and hint (null, or {code, message, found_at} saying what to change). warnings is an empty array when none. existing_mail_provider means this hostname already has MX at another provider. Custom domains are included on Starter (15) and Pro (200). Free includes 0 and returns HTTP 402 plan_limit_exceeded. Publish exactly the records returned, with their host, type, value, priority for MX, and ttl. The receiving MX hostname and the DKIM value come from that response. Do not invent them. dns.mode automatic means Cooper wrote the records in an active Cloudflare zone it already controls. dns.mode external means you publish them at your DNS host. Cooper does not register a domain, create a zone, or move nameservers. Keep one SPF TXT with a single include; an existing SPF is merged into it. A DMARC p=reject record is left as published and blocks mail until DKIM for that domain verifies. mail.receiving and mail.sending stay false until the matching records verify. Then POST /api/v1/inboxes with domain creates username@domain. Failure codes: unauthorized.
name: cooper_list_domains

data.description: Items on this page, in the order the tool description gives.

created_at.description: ISO-8601 time the object was created.

dns.description: {mode}: automatic when Cooper wrote the records, external when you publish them.

id.description: Domain id (dom_…). Pass it as domain_id to cooper_verify_domain.

idempotent.description: True when this result replays an earlier request with the same key instead of acting again.

mail.description: {receiving, sending, inboxes} flags. Each turns true once its records verify.

notices.description: Usage notices, such as [{type: limit_warning, resource, used, limit, upgrade_url}] at 80 percent of a plan limit.

records.description: DNS records to publish [{host, type, value, priority, ttl, status, found, hint}]. Publish exactly these.

status.description: pending until DNS matches, then verified.

status_detail.description: Plain-language note on what is still pending.

warnings.description: Problems found in existing DNS, such as existing_mail_provider. Empty when none.

object.description: Object type name, such as list, message, or thread.

title: List custom domains
